product.description: Când gazeta locală anunță că va avea loc o crimă la Little Paddocks, vineri, 29 octombrie, la ora 18.30, tot satul, crezând că este vorba de un joc, se prezintă la întâlnire. Dar, brusc, toate luminile se sting, se aud împușcături, apoi este descoperit un tânăr necunoscut, ucis. Iar acesta este doar începutul. Alte crime urmează, și numai Miss Marple va fi în stare să soluționeze cea mai ingenioasă crimă.

# The Announced Crime by Litera - A Classic Mystery Novel

Dive into a captivating world of suspense and intrigue with *The Announced Crime*. By the acclaimed brand Litera, this novel plunges readers into a gathering where every event seems scriptedâuntil it isn't. If you are looking for an engrossing mystery that showcases brilliant deduction, look no further.

## The Mystery at Little Paddocks

When the local newspaper announces that a crime will take place at Little Paddocks on Friday, October 29th, at 6:30 PM, the entire village gathers, assuming it's merely a game. What they don't expect is the sudden darkness, the sound of gunshots, and the shocking discovery of an unknown young man, dead. This initial incident is merely the beginning.

As other crimes follow, making the situation increasingly dangerous, only Miss Marple possesses the keen insight needed to solve the most ingenious mystery. The narrative skillfully guides you through a web of secrets, misdirection, and classic English village drama, all while keeping you guessing until the final page.

## Why Read This Detective Fiction Classic?

*The Announced Crime* delivers everything fans of Agatha Christie-style mysteries crave: sophisticated plotting, memorable characters, and an atmosphere thick with suspicion. The narrative structure ensures that even when Miss Marple is near a breakthrough, new red herrings pop up, guaranteeing a thrilling read from start to finish. This book is perfect for readers who enjoy deep character studies combined with high-stakes crime solving.
